text:
Maya (CEO): starting a short live thread for follow-ups on today's reorg/headcount section. Ask one-off questions here and we'll answer quickly.
Claire (Staff SWE): who actually approves new headcount? manager, director, finance, or exec?
Priya (Head of People): reqs need manager + director signoff, then TA and finance review. anything above team token limits goes to the exec hiring committee.
Mateo (Director, Product): are teams allowed to reallocate their tokens across roles (e.g., swap a junior SWE for a TPM)?
Jonas (VP Eng): yes within reason. managers can trade tokens across role families for the quarter but must submit a swap request in the allocation sheet so finance stays aligned.
Claire (Staff SWE): EU/APAC hiring  will the focus be US-only or distributed?
Priya (Head of People): hires are global. we prioritize local candidates for timezones but most infra/platform roles are open in EU/APAC as well; hiring timeframes may vary by market.
Claire (Staff SWE): if someone is moved out of a removed team, do they keep their title/level?
Priya (Head of People): yes  title and level are preserved during internal reassignments unless the person agrees to change. compensation adjustments only with consent.
Mateo (Director, Product): will product roadmap timelines be pushed if hires take longer? any buffer?
Jonas (VP Eng): teams should plan conservatively; we expect some sprints to be impacted but the intent is to reduce long-term blockers. product PMs will get a temporary capacity buffer for critical launches.
Claire (Staff SWE): about the hiring bar  any relaxation to hit numbers faster?
Maya (CEO): no. quality stays the priority. faster process, same bar.
hiring-bot: poll created "Do you understand how headcount approvals work now?" options: Yes / Somewhat / No
Priya (Head of People): follow-ups i'll drop: 1) one-pager on approval flow, 2) allocation spreadsheet link, 3) internal mobility form. office hours tomorrow 4pm PT for managers.
Claire (Staff SWE): thanks  helpful and concise.
Maya (CEO): thanks all  we'll keep this thread updated with links and the finalized org map by Friday.
